Question: Aslam-o-alakum I am from gujrat.in our state and city 'Rajkot'people make lighting decoration in the month of 'Muahram' calling it 'Rosni'. So my question is that is it okay lighting decoration in the month of 'Muahram'? Answer ID: 28895 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 167/124/H=1432) According to Islam, this practice (of lighting and decoration) is haram and a sin. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
